caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object positioned vertically and centrally on a plain, light beige background enclosed in a fine rectangular border. The object consists of five pairs of dark brown, straight bars arranged in an overlapping, crisscross, scissor-like pattern connected by round rivets at the intersections, forming a collapsible, expandable structure. At the top, each end of the uppermost bars curves outward into a circular handle with an open loop, while at the bottom, the ends of the lowest bars extend into downward-facing hooks. In the lower left corner, there is a small, simplified line drawing of the same object, identified with the label "16th Scavenger," showing its form in outline. The signature "Samuel T. Freeman Del. 259.1" appears in the lower right corner outside the inner border. The entire composition is visually centered with ample even space surrounding the primary object.
title: Tongs
